source_read: Independent targeted check of tasks_reader410.json, using only sibling claims_reader410.json for claim context and the four original supplied PDFs named in the tasks. Procedure read: docs/METHODS.md sections 5.5 and 6.2–6.3, and targeted/BRIEF.md. Extracted original PDF text locally and read the assigned passages. Viewed independently generated 150-dpi text-page renders, or 300-dpi renders where text shared a table/figure page: Freeman_2019_CBDInfluenceTHC_SR.pdf printed pp.15,18,22,25 (PDF pp.16,19,23,26), with Table 1 printed pp.65–71 (PDF pp.66–72) rendered and viewed at 300 dpi; Klevebrant_2022_CaffeinePanicDisorderMA.pdf printed pp.22,24–28 (PDF pp.1,3–7), with Table 1 pp.25–26 and Fig.2 p.26 viewed at 300 dpi; Jones_1997_MealsAlcoholPharmacokinetics.pdf printed pp.522–524 (PDF pp.2–4), with Table 1 p.524 viewed at 300 dpi; VanNhat_2026_ProtectiveStrategiesTrialsMA.pdf pp.2–3,5–11 (matching PDF pages), with Table 1 p.6, Table 2 p.7, contextual Table 3 p.8, contextual Fig.2 p.5, and main forest plots Figs.3–6 pp.9–10 viewed at 300 dpi. Independently transcribed and recalculated participant/event totals, protocol and study-row counts, hour/minute and weight-dose conversions, percentages/CVs, forest-plot union/omissions, and all-Table-1 sample totals; scratch arithmetic retained under tmp/reader410. No web or other sources, other readers' outputs, live claims/cards or adjudication logs/plans were read. Underlying primary studies, supplementary files and PROSPERO protocols were not read; unresolved primary methods, dose basis, prospective planning and analysis denominators remain unverified. Klevebrant's actual pagination was verified from the PDF: printed p.22 is PDF p.1. All ten task anchors were checked; no required target render or assigned passage remains unread.

results.note: Participant-history and timing entries match. Independently, eight/six/two hours equal 480/360/120 minutes, confirming Hunt's middle-time conflict. These are review-reported conditions, not verified primary regimens or practical advice; qualifies fits.

The three non-completions and both outcome passages match. Fourteen is a study label, not a verified analysis denominator; separate placebo significances establish no active-treatment difference. The explicit divided-attention contrast and qualifies role fit.

Design/order counts and 244/122 totals recomputed. Figure 2 shows 20% unclear for the combined participant/personnel domain; this does not establish unblinded participants. Tancer's caffeine-only footnote is present. Supports fits.

Independently counted 2 capsule, 5 coffee and 3 other-liquid protocols; seven fixed 480 mg rows. At 75 kg, 7 and 10 mg/kg give 525 and 750 mg; citrate basis remains unresolved. Descriptive study conditions; supports fits.

Events and percentages recomputed: 121/237 = 51.0549%, 2/115 = 1.7391%. Results support these totals; Table 1 prints Klein 5/17 alongside n=7 and 71%, an internal inconsistency. Placebo absence is reported, not a verified complete paired denominator.

Seven 480-mg rows and both weight conversions confirmed independently. The abstract's below-480-mg caveat is present. The review does not resolve the citrate dose basis; no caffeine-equivalent boundary or advice is inferred. Qualifies fits.

Timing starts with dosing. All CVs match Table 1 as explicitly qualified; independently, intravenous AUC CV is 446/4786 x 100 = 9.32%, versus printed 10%. Other rounded CVs agree. Qualifies fits; study observations are not advice.

Three PNF adjunct rows confirmed. Six to nine describes main outcome pools, not established subgroup sizes; self-report limitations are under section 4.1. Corrected scope and locator preserve the qualifying interpretation and avoid practical advice.
results.corrected_extracted: Three of the four adjunct-role trials combined the strategies with personalized normative feedback (Table 2; editors' count). The authors caution that the apparently larger adjunct effects cannot be interpreted as evidence of superiority because subgroups included relatively few studies and could not fully account for intervention intensity, delivery format or other components; these estimates therefore do not isolate the strategies' contribution. The main outcome pools, rather than established subgroup sizes, contain six to nine trials (Results 3.4). The authors describe subgroup findings as exploratory and identify self-reported outcomes, attrition and predominantly university-student samples as limitations.
results.corrected_locator: Results 3.4 and 3.4.1–3.4.4, main outcome pool sizes (p.6); Table 2, Intervention Type and Role of PBS columns (p.7); Discussion, subgroup-interpretation paragraph beginning "Subgroup analyses" (p.10); Discussion, attrition and generalizability paragraphs before 4.1, and 4.1 Strengths and limitations, final two paragraphs (p.11)

results.note: Section 2.7 explicitly describes both diagnostics and exclusion sensitivity analyses. Prespecified refers separately to subgroup analyses; the unread protocol cannot verify prospective planning of influence exclusions. Qualifies fits.

Independently transcribed plot rows give 9/6/7/6, 11 unique trials and the four stated absences. All 15 Table 1 rows sum to 15,714/6,587; outcome-specific denominators are not those totals. No study-specific omission explanations found in main methods/results. Qualifies fits.
